description: This file provides a fake implementation of an interface for nftables, including structures and methods for managing tables, chains, rules, sets, and maps, primarily for unit testing purposes.

classes.name: Fake
classes.description: A fake implementation of the Interface for nftables, used for unit testing.

classes.name: FakeTable
classes.description: Represents a fake nftables table with chains, sets, and maps.

classes.name: FakeChain
classes.description: Wraps a Chain with associated rules for the fake implementation.

classes.name: FakeSet
classes.description: Wraps a Set with its elements for the fake implementation.

classes.name: FakeMap
classes.description: Wraps a Map with its elements for the fake implementation.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists objects of a specified type (chains, sets, maps) in the fake table.

methods.name: ListRules
methods.description: Lists rules in a specified chain.

methods.name: ListElements
methods.description: Lists elements of a set or map.

methods.name: NewTransaction
methods.description: Creates a new transaction for the fake nftables interface.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes a transaction and updates the fake table.

methods.name: Check
methods.description: Checks the validity of a transaction without applying changes.

methods.name: Dump
methods.description: Dumps the current state of the fake nftables configuration.

methods.name: ParseDump
methods.description: Parses a dump string to restore state in the fake implementation.

methods.name: FindElement
methods.description: Finds an element in a set or map by key.
